title: Image deletion retention decision
purpose: Document the unresolved deletion policy for uploaded images when the owner selects Delete.

scope.text: Deletion retention after the owner selects Delete for an uploaded image has two competing requests.

requirements.text: immediate permanent deletion of an uploaded image when its owner selects Delete
the same deleted image remain recoverable by its owner for 30 days after Delete

stories.text: If a human selects immediate permanent deletion, an owner can delete an uploaded image and the image is permanently deleted immediately.
acceptance_criteria: Given a human has selected immediate permanent deletion, when an owner selects Delete for an uploaded image, then that image is permanently deleted immediately.

stories.text: If a human selects 30-day recoverability, an owner can recover a deleted image within 30 days after selecting Delete.
acceptance_criteria: Given a human has selected 30-day recoverability, when an owner deletes an uploaded image, then the image remains recoverable by the owner for 30 days after Delete.

dependencies.text: No stakeholder has authority to choose between these requests yet.
The deletion retention policy is unresolved.

risks.text: Immediate permanent deletion would leave no 30-day recoverability, and 30-day recoverability would prevent immediate permanent deletion.

open_questions: Which retention policy should a human select: immediate permanent deletion or 30-day recoverability?
Who has authority to select the policy?
What happens to a deleted image after the 30-day recoverability period if that alternative is selected?
